caseName: Orpinuk v. United States Department of Health & Human Services
caseNameFull: Orpinuk v. United States Department of Health and Human Services

opinions.text: C. A. Fed. Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until December 22, 1986, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 45(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.

opinions.author: Brennanmarshallstevens
opinions.text:
Justice Brennan, Justice Marshall, and Justice Stevens,

dissenting.

For the reasons expressed in Brown v. Herald Co., 464 U. S. 928 (1983), we would deny the petition for writ of certiorari *982without reaching the merits of the motion to proceed in forma pauperis.
